move: image unmasks upward, serif lines rise, rule draws, re-cover and lift
how: A cream stage split into copy on the left and a tall photo on the right. A stage-coloured mask over the photo scales to scaleY 0 from the bottom edge (expo.inOut 1.2s) while the photo settles from scale 1.25 to 1.05 linearly over the whole 4s. The case-study index lifts in at 8%, three serif title lines rise out of overflow masks (yPercent 110 to 0, expo.out 0.9s, 100ms stagger) from 11%, the description lifts (power3.out), a hairline rule draws from the left (scaleX, expo.out 0.9s) at 26%, tag pills lift in at 80ms stagger and the studio credit fades in. At 80% the mask re-covers the photo from the top (expo.inOut 0.7s), the title lines drop up out of their masks (power3.in, 50ms stagger) and the remaining copy fades up and away.
adapt: Replace the index, three title lines, description, tags, credit and the photo; recolour the cream and ink. Keep the 1.2s expo.inOut unmask and the 0.9s expo.out line rises at 100ms stagger.
port: mount(el, shot) builds the copy column and the masked picture inside el. animate(el, shot, D) returns the same timeline with the exit at 0.8 of D; from() tweens should become fromTo with immediateRender:false.
caveats: from() tweens; use immediateRender:false if built after first paint
ends on an empty stage, restarts with the unmask
